summary: iter296 P0 backend regression — 6/6 new iter296 tests PASSED, 60/60 combined iter290-296 PASSED. Bilingual notifications (BUG 4) verified end-to-end in DB + UI bell. Auction-end propagation (BUG 1), winner email (BUG 2), seller email (BUG 3), and Stripe SDK v8 compat fix all confirmed. Data repair script idempotent. CRITICAL REGRESSION FOUND on BUG 5: the actual seller dashboard widget consumes `/api/dashboard/seller` (NOT `/api/listings/my-listings`) — and the dashboard endpoint was NOT updated with the iter296 union convention. As a result, the user-visible 'Articles Vendus / Sold Items' counter still shows 0 for charbel911@gmail.com despite the my-listings API returning counts.sold=1. This is the very symptom the user reported. Main agent must extend the union to /api/dashboard/seller.

critical.issue: BUG 5 REGRESSION — `routes/dashboard.py:73` still filters `sold_listings = [l for l in all_listings if l.get('status') == 'sold']`. Same line 70 (_ENDED_STATUSES) lists 'sold','ended','expired','completed' for the ENDED tab, but the SOLD bucket only accepts literal status=='sold'. Marketplace listings end with status='ended' + winner_user_id set, so they are excluded. The frontend SellerDashboard.js binds `dashboard?.sold_listings || 0` for the 'Articles Vendus' card — verified 0 on UI for charbel911 even though /api/listings/my-listings reports counts.sold=1. Also total_sales (line 108) is summed from sold_listings only, so 'Ventes Totales' / 'Paiement Net' cards are also 0. Same listing 'table test' (id 8d9ece47-13c4-4b1b-86fa-1eb43e52ad19) ended with bidder 0f258fed-... but is invisible to the dashboard.

minor.issue: Two routes are registered at the same path: routes/profiles.py:262 (annual_volume shape, registered first → WINS) and routes/users.py:150 (listings/bidding/financials shape with the iter296 union fix). The users.py fix on lines 169-194 is unreachable in production because profiles.py shadows the route. If the dashboard ever switches to /me/stats, the iter296 union will not take effect.

Confirmed flaky-only: re-running the entire iter290-296 suite hits a 429 rate-limit on the dashboard counter test (test runs ~60 logins in ~20s). Not a real bug — single-run gives 200 OK. Suggest spacing iter296's seller-login test or using a long-lived token fixture to harden CI.

ui_bugs.issue: Card stuck at '0' for charbel911@gmail.com even though the 'table test' listing ended with a winner. Backend bug above is the root cause; frontend code itself is correct (line 343 binds dashboard?.sold_listings).

rca of the issue: The iter296 P0 patch fixed BUG 5 partially: routes/listings.py (my-listings), routes/users.py (sellers/{id}, me/stats) were updated with the new union. routes/dashboard.py (/api/dashboard/seller) was NOT updated. Since the actual Seller Dashboard page (frontend/src/pages/SellerDashboard.js) consumes the latter endpoint via `axios.get(API+'/dashboard/seller')` and binds `dashboard.sold_listings` to the visible 'Articles Vendus / Sold Items' card, the user still sees 0 even with the patch deployed. Reproduction: login as charbel911@gmail.com → /seller/dashboard → 'Articles Vendus' card shows 0; curl /api/dashboard/seller returns sold_listings: 0; but curl /api/listings/my-listings returns counts.sold: 1. Mitigation: apply the same $or union to routes/dashboard.py lines 73, 76, 83-84, 90 so sold/ended/total_sales/buyer_contact all reflect marketplace ended-with-winner items.
